en.title: Reduce CPU work on first atlas upload
en.body: The shared 2D renderer recognizes blocks with runs of transparent or opaque pixels and avoids color-table lookups there for those pixels. Intermediate alpha, mip generation and resource ownership keep their existing behavior.

zh.title: 降低图集首次上传的 CPU 开销
zh.body: 共享 2D 渲染器可识别透明或不透明像素成片分布的图集区域，为这些像素省去颜色查表。半透明像素、mip 层生成和资源所有权沿用原有行为。
